description: BB squeeze scenario: flat closes produce zero population stdDev, causing all three bands to collapse to the same value (upper == middle == lower). Period 20, multiplier 2.0. This is the classic Bollinger Squeeze when volatility is zero. Output length = 25 - 20 + 1 = 6.

expectedOutput.note: stdDev=0 when all prices identical. upper==middle==lower for all windows.
